Tahap pertama berfokus pada pembentukan: The first phase focuses on establishing foundational competencies as a medical student. Students learn effective self-directed learning, build professional medical ethics, develop doctor-patient communication skills, and master foundational biomedical sciences.
Tahap kedua berfokus pada pemahaman tent: The second phase centers on understanding disease mechanisms and their correlation with normal human physiology. Students bridge basic science knowledge with clinical presentations observed in real-world patients.
Pada tahun ketiga, fokus pembelajaran de: In the third year, learning deepens through integrated clinical knowledge. Students apply pathophysiological concepts to analyze complex cases and refine essential diagnostic skills required by the competency curriculum.
Tahap keempat menekankan pendekatan meny: The fourth phase emphasizes a holistic approach to understanding and managing health conditions. Students evaluate biological, psychological, social, cultural, and environmental determinants of health during clinical care delivery.
Dilaksanakan di Rumah Sakit Pendidikan U: Conducted at the Primary Teaching Hospital RSUD Praya, specialized network hospitals (Mutiara Sukma Psychiatric Hospital, NTB Eye Hospital, Bhayangkara Hospital), and regional health centers under direct supervision of medical specialists and clinical educators.
Mahasiswa belajar memecahkan skenario ka: Students analyze authentic clinical case scenarios in guided small groups led by experienced medical faculty tutors.
Pelatihan keterampilan klinis langsung m: Hands-on clinical skills training utilizing high-fidelity anatomical manikins and standardized patient simulations.
Penguatan konsep dasar keilmuan kedokter: Interactive reinforcement of foundational medical science principles delivered by biomedical researchers and clinical specialists.
